capabilities: Show an Md button while editing a Markdown file
Open a formatting panel on pointer hover
Apply headings, bold, italic, highlight, and quote
Insert lists, inline code, code blocks, and links
Run locally without telemetry or network calls
disambiguation: Despite its name, it does not hide or ignore Markdown; it adds a hover toolbar that inserts formatting.
extras: Manual installation only; no community plugin marketplace install instructions are given. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Applying common Markdown formatting requires memorizing and typing syntax, which slows editing for users who prefer pointing at format options.
summary: Hover formatting toolbar that applies Markdown headings, emphasis, lists, links, highlight, and code without typing syntax.
